waps.endHint: Ending the event does not resume permits automatically.

zoneProfiles.title: Zone access requirements
zoneProfiles.subtitle: What a worker needs to enter each zone. Edits can only make a zone stricter.
zoneProfiles.tightenOnly: Loosening a zone's requirements is refused; change the zone itself instead.
zoneProfiles.ratioHint: Workers per escort. Cannot exceed the project setting.

passSetup.title: Pass categories and areas
passSetup.subtitle: The airport operator's pass types and the area codes printed on cards.
passSetup.bgRequiredHint: Unescorted passes normally need a background check.

passes.applicationsHint: Airport ID pass requests and their progress with the pass office.
passes.passesHint: Passes issued by the airport authority, their validity and custody.
passes.newHint: The application starts as a draft. Attach the ID copy, then submit.
passes.staleHint: Lodged with the pass office {days} days ago without a decision.
passes.maxDays: This category allows up to {days} days.
passes.escortedCategory: Escorted pass: the holder must be escorted in restricted areas.
passes.justificationHint: Explain the work. If an area is outside the worker's sites, give at least 20 characters.
passes.idCopyHint: Stored encrypted and deleted automatically after the decision.
passes.outcomeNoteHint: Do not write security reasons here.
passes.passNoHint: Exactly as printed on the card.
passes.expiryHint: Exactly as printed on the card.

help.submit: Checks the worker is mobilised, has a photo, a valid ID and an active contractor.
help.return: Send the application back to draft with a comment.
help.endorse: Confirms the sponsor and records the induction and requirement checks.
help.lodge: Record when it was handed to the pass office and their reference.
help.bg: Record only what the authority reported. Do not record reasons.
help.approve: The authority approved the pass. Background check must be cleared when required.
help.refuse: The authority refused. Others will only see “Refused by issuing authority”.
help.issue: Enter the pass exactly as printed. Granted areas can be fewer than requested.
help.cancel: The approved pass was not collected or the worker left.
help.withdraw: The application stops here and cannot be reopened.

adps.title: Airside driving permits
adps.subtitle: Who may drive airside, in which areas and vehicle classes, and their offence points.
adps.applyHint: The driver needs an active unescorted airport pass covering the category's areas.
adps.applied: Application saved. Record the tests, then issue.
adps.categoryHint: Manoeuvring covers apron and airside roads too.
adps.licenceHint: The licence number is not stored.
adps.thresholdReached: Points threshold reached: the permit is suspended for the set period.
adps.testsHint: Theory and practical tests must be within 90 days before issue.
adps.rtfRequired: Manoeuvring needs radio (RTF) competence and a practical test that covered the manoeuvring area.
adps.issueHint: Enter the permit number and dates as printed.
adps.withdrawHint: The application stops and cannot be issued.
adps.offencesHint: Offences recorded airside and the points they carry.
adps.recordOffenceHint: Points come from the offence list at the time of the offence.
adps.immediateHint: This offence suspends the driving permit immediately.
adps.withdrawOffenceHint: Points are recalculated. A suspension already applied is not lifted automatically.

vehicles.title: Vehicles & plant
vehicles.subtitle: Contractor vehicles and mobile plant, their documents and working heights.
vehicles.searchHint: Vehicle no., fleet no. or plate
vehicles.docsExpiredHint: A document has expired. Its vehicle permits are suspended until a new date is saved.
vehicles.vinHint: Road vehicles: 17-character VIN (no I, O or Q).
vehicles.personalPlate: Plates of individually owned vehicles are personal data.
vehicles.heightsHint: Working height is with boom or mast fully extended, including load and rigging.
vehicles.workingBelowTravel: Working height cannot be below travel height.
vehicles.applyAvpHint: Choose the airside areas. Then record the inspection and issue.
vehicles.withdrawHint: A withdrawn vehicle cannot be used again on this project.
vehicles.inspectionHint: Every item must pass or be not applicable. Some items cannot be N/A.
vehicles.issueHint: The inspection must be passed within 14 days before issue.
vehicles.reissueHint: A new QR is issued; the old sticker stops working at once.

notams.title: NOTAM works requests
notams.subtitle: Requests to Airport Operations and the NOTAMs issued for airside works. Times are UTC.
notams.newHint: The platform does not file NOTAMs; it records the request and the NOTAM as issued.
notams.timesUtcHint: Enter times in UTC. Riyadh local time is UTC+3.
notams.lateHint: Submitted with less than the {days}-day lead time.
notams.lateWarning: Less than {days} days before start. A justification is required.
notams.replacedDone: Replacement {no} recorded and linked to the same permits.

help.submit: Sends the request to Airport Operations and records the time.
help.forward: Airport Operations forwarded the request to AIS.
help.issue: Enter the NOTAM exactly as issued (items B, C and E).
help.replace: Creates a new record for the NOTAMR and moves the linked permits to it.
help.cancel: Linked active permits are suspended within a minute.

obstacles.title: Obstacle & crane clearances
obstacles.subtitle: Height checks against the obstacle limitation surfaces and the authority's decisions.
obstacles.newHint: Heights are checked as you type; the result shows whether a clearance is needed.
obstacles.vehicleOrDesc: Pick a vehicle or describe the equipment.
obstacles.heightsHint: Highest point with boom raised, including load and rigging.
obstacles.olsLimitHint: Leave empty to use the zone's limit. Give the drawing ref if different.
obstacles.previewHint: Fill in location, heights and period to see the check.
obstacles.notRequired: No clearance required for this configuration.
obstacles.systemSuspendedHint: Suspended because no issued NOTAM covers today. It lifts automatically when one does.
obstacles.lateHint: Submitted with less than the required lead time.
obstacles.isLate: Less than the required lead time
obstacles.penetrationRule: It penetrates the surface: approval needs NOTAM-required and obstruction-light conditions and an authority ref.
obstacles.capHint: Becomes a hard cap for linked work permits.

help.submit: Submit to the authority. A short lead needs a justification.
help.decide: Record the authority's decision exactly as given.

gates.title: Gates
gates.subtitle: Gates, the zones they protect and the registered check devices.
gates.formHint: A site gate with no zones checks the whole site.
gates.logSubtitle: Every gate check, read-only. Includes entries admitted despite denial.
gates.zonesHint: Zones of the selected site. Leave empty for a site gate.
gates.zonesRequired: Select at least one zone for this gate type.
gates.devicesHint: Gate devices log in with their token and can only run gate checks at this gate.
gates.registerHint: The device will be bound to gate {gate}.
gates.tokenOnce: Device registered. Copy the token now.
gates.tokenWarning: This token is shown only once. Anyone with it can run gate checks at this gate.
gates.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the token and copy it manually.
gates.tokenUse: On the gate tablet, open the Gate check screen and choose “Device login”.
gates.revokeHint: The device is logged out at once and its token stops working. Register it again to get a new token.
gates.activateHint: Checks can be run at this gate again.
gates.deactivateHint: No checks can be run at this gate until it is activated again.
gates.subject: Subject

accessSettings.title: Access settings
accessSettings.subtitle: Project rules for inductions, passes, escorts, permits and gate checks. Changes are audited.
accessSettings.readOnly: Only the HSE Manager can change these settings.
accessSettings.absenceHint: Days of absence before re-induction. Empty = off. 30–365.
accessSettings.listInvalid: Enter whole numbers separated by commas.
accessSettings.suspendedContractorHint: Warn lets workers of a suspended contractor in with an amber warning.
accessSettings.blockHint: Block can only be chosen once the module that checks it is live. Until then hooks show as warnings.

sectionHint.driving: ADP and AVP validity, tests and penalty points.
sectionHint.works: Permit length, lead times and obstacle heights.
sectionHint.lifecycle: Suspensions, suspended contractors at the gate and data retention.
sectionHint.alerts: When expiry alerts are sent: days before for long credentials, hours before for short ones.
sectionHint.hooks: Requirements checked by later modules (training, certificates, medical).

gate.offline: No connection — call the HSE Officer
gate.noPermission: You do not have permission to run gate checks.
gate.loadFailed: The gate screen could not be loaded.
gate.deviceRevoked: This device was revoked. Ask the HSE team for a new device token.
gate.deviceLoginHint: For a registered gate tablet. Enter the device token issued when the device was registered.
gate.userLoginHint: Guards and HSE staff with gate-check permission.
gate.noGates: No active gate is available to you.
gate.rateLimited: Too many checks. Wait a moment and try again.
gate.readyHint: Scan the QR code on the card, sticker or permit, or type the printed reference (a vehicle with no sticker: its vehicle number).

gate.admitHint: The platform has no override. Record why entry was allowed; the HSE Officer and HSE Manager are alerted at once.
